title: Attendance Card Signing
text: Sign your physical card at the Guard Room desk before entering office premises. Unsigned entries will be marked absent.
author: HR Department

title: Lock Your Workstation
text: Always lock your screen (Win + L) when stepping away from your desk. Leaving systems unlocked violates security policy.
author: IT Department

title: IT Awareness Training
text: Mandatory Annual IT Awareness Training is scheduled for Monday, 12th Oct 2026. All staff must attend the session.
author: IT Department
